frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We made it! But all that space junk made it a bumpy ride...

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Wow, the Grand Composer created this whole planet? He must be planning something sinister.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: I can see a platform over there, let's check it out!

frames.heading: Crescendo
frames.body: Greetings, troublemaker, I am Crescendo. What brings you to this planet?

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We're here to stop the Grand Composer from silencing the Universe!!!

frames.heading: Crescendo
frames.body: Such bold intentions. But you are too late, the hub is almost complete. Our Silence Amplifiers are priming, almost ready to deploy.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We're not here to be part of some cosmic symphony where we don't have a voice!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Yeah, we groove to our own beat. No one's turning down our volume!

frames.heading: Crescendo
frames.body: Very well. The first trial awaits you here, on the Platform of Crescendo. Are you ready?

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We were born ready. Bring it on!
